title: [Master] Bug 645040: Expense Agent: BC Approval Workflow - Improve error message when Approval User Setup is missing
summary: Expense approval workflow now shows a clear, actionable error message when the current user lacks a User Setup record, with a link to open the configuration page.
key_points: New helper function GetCurrentUserSetupForApproval replaces generic platform error with user-friendly messaging
Error message instructs users to configure their User Setup and explains why it is needed
Navigation action allows users to open the Approval User Setup page directly from the error
Error helper guarded to check read permissions on User Setup before showing navigation
Applied consistently across all expense report and approval workflow pages
